contexts.text: Thou shalt make for it a closure (border) of a span round about () = conjunction there with truth from the Divine. A closure = the ultimate of termination, because it was outside the border; thus conjunction with truth and with the Divine. Explained.
Thou shalt make a border of gold for the closure thereof round about () = the termination of the sphere of Divine good... The closure = conjunction with truth from the Divine.
Over against the closure shall be rings for houses to the staves () = power thence derived. The closure, over against which the rings were to be = conjunction in ultimates with truth from the Divine.
The reason the border was made of gold, was that it represented a closure from good.
It prevents the passing of that love beyond the enclosure of the heart.
The separation of truth from good through falsity and evil is signified by I will rend the closure of their heart ().
